checks.scope: Hub-deletion actual anchors, trace accounting and literal B4 guard

checks.method: Independently enumerate ordered deficits 0<=a<=b<=c<=8, pair counts p,q<=a and r<=b, and t<=2, using the inequalities and three equality guards of R15ScalarClosure.lean. The t bound follows from Y+3t<=8.
checks.observation: Exactly50 states satisfy the capacities and the two numerical inequalities before equality guards; none satisfies all three guards. Removing any one guard while retaining the other two admits exactly3 states. Witnesses have a=b=c=1,t=2 and respectively (p,q,r)=(1,0,0),(0,1,0),(0,0,1). These checks cover the full geometrically permitted deficit domain and confirm the one-unit contradiction; the universal arithmetic proof remains the separately compiled result, not a new compilation here.
checks.scope: Hub scalar contradiction and equality-boundary sensitivity

checks.method: Inspect LOW15-A3-star-fibre-reduction.md, The support of a degree15 star and Concrete one- and two-deletion requirements, together with the current direct-Jin route. Enumerate all266 deviation vectors and86 nonindependent supports with weighted-edge lower cost at most4; test nonisolated weights and exact feasibility of isolated weights by their integer capacity interval.
checks.observation: All2128 cyclic mass-identity instances hold. Exactly392 support/endpoint-weight signatures are feasible, realizing precisely the eight cyclic four-index windows. Every feasible interior weight is at least4; endpoint weights are1 or2. Direct evaluation of the two cover-count identities gives minimum11 for endpoint weight1 and minimum12 for weight2. The argument uses forced nonedges under a homomorphism and counts actual distinct nonstar members. This check reproduces the lower requirements, not the separate2541-case upper-cover census.
checks.scope: Degree15 nonindependent A3 supports and deletion-cover lower bounds

findings.disposition: The independent scalar and literal-cover checks below confirm the restrictions, including retention of root pairs p0i and omission of the missing hub anchor. The relaxed witnesses concern weakened scalar systems, not sunflower-free counterexamples.

Actual anchors, residual internal traces and exterior completions are retained. Relaxed scalar examples confirm that the stated equality guards matter. No mathematical revision is required within this scope; this is not a complete-proof replay or publication approval.
